source_runtime_truth: manual is initialized once from c.classList.contains('carousel--manual') and is never reassigned.
start() always calls stop() first, then starts a 4000ms interval only when not manual, not reduced-motion, slides.length>=2 and the carousel is connected.
Successful arrow/dot/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/qualifying swipe navigation calls go(...) followed by start(); on a non-manual instance this resets/restarts the interval.
mouseenter and focusin call stop(); mouseleave and focusout call start(). Compound exit-order behavior therefore follows those raw events without independent hover/focus flags.

drop(slide) removes the slide/dot, reindexes and clamps. If no slides remain it calls stop(), hides the nearest project-card__extra/hero-proof owner or the carousel, and returns. If exactly one slide remains it calls stop() because slides.length<2, then go(...). If two or more remain it does not stop or restart the existing timer solely because of removal.
The previous statement that drop() itself never calls stop() is superseded and must not be used.
